content.title: Coachella Weekend 2 is your only chance to see Justin Bieber in 2026
content.text: April 12, 2026Updated April 16, 2026, 3:58 p.m. ETJustin Bieber is scheduled to perform during the second weekend of Coachella on Saturday, April 18, 2026.The pop star does not have an official tour scheduled for 2026, making Coachella his only confirmed live appearance.Tickets for the second weekend of Coachella are still available for purchase.The F.O.M.O. (fear of missing out) from missing Justin Bieber's Coachella performance is REAL. But, you're in luck, because he's heading back for weekend 2 of the festival on Saturday.The heat wasn't from Coachella Valley's infamous weather, it was Bieber Fever taking over once again after Justin Bieber included hits like "Baby" and "Yukon" in his Coachella 2026 set list, plus a surprise appearance from Kid Laroi for "Stay." If you couldn't get enough of the pop star, I have bad news for you, he has very limited appearances currently scheduled. In fact, your only other shot to see Justin Bieber live in 2026 is Saturday, April 18 when he headlines Coachella Weekend 2.Below we'll break down your chances to see Justin Bieber live in concert in 2026:Is Justin Bieber touring in 2026?There might be one less lonely girl...but there are still a lot of sad Beliebers, as there's no official confirmation of Justin Bieber touring in 2026. Bieber's last tour was the Justice World Tour which kicked off in January 2022 but ended early due to the artist's health issues. That means, as of right now, your only chance to see Justin Bieber is at Coachella's second weekend.There are rumors that more could be coming, but nothing official has been confirmed. If an announcement is made, the USA TODAY Shopping team will let you know how to get tickets as soon as they're available.Get last-minute Coachella tickets for Saturday, April 18The headliners will remain the same for Coachella's second weekend, with Justin Bieber taking the Coachella Stage around 9 p.m. PST. Tickets are still available for Week 2. As of publication, weekend passes for April 17-19 are starting at $2,269.Shop Coachella Weekend 2 ticketsGet ready to party in the California desert with Coachella tickets to see headliners like Justin Bieber, Karol G and Sabrina Carpenter April 17-19. But, the 2026 version is jam packed with nostalgia and Justin's personal touch.
